Board 02 — money on screen #1371 · #1369 · #1368 · R5 #1310 #1311

Money on screen. ①a #1371: an edit of an imported trade's figures leaves its stored cash. Q4 — answer (b), adopted by the ADR-0053 amendment of 2026-11-02: the drawer shows the cash field, prefilled with what the new figures derive, and saves what the field states; a figure off by more than a cent is refused. Variant (a), the cash re-derived silently, is drawn for contrast. „(a)“ in a comment flips it, as the ADR says.

①b #1369 and ①c #1368 are conformance repairs (before/after): Sprint 22's valuation rule, a held position with no quote at its last own trade price, named where it is read („Handelspreis · 14.03.2025“, „zum Handelspreis“). ①d draws two of Sprint 22's R5 notes after the fact, as built.

dashed = new or changed · amber edge = a synthetic row written into the shipped markup of a real one (the seed has no such row) · 1 ties a change to its section's text. Synthetic data only.

①a — #1371: the cash of an imported trade follows an edit only when stated Transaktionen → Arbolia Inc., Kauf 16.04.2026 → Bearbeiten

The seed's imported Arbolia buy is the ADR's example: 10 at 80,00 EUR, fees 5,00, taxes 1,00, cash 806,00. Each frame is that buy opened for editing with its price typed as 81, never saved. (The note about the booking currency is today's, #1335: Arbolia trades in USD and was booked in EUR without legs.)

Saving this stores price 81,00 and keeps cash 806,00: the cash balance and the holding's cost read 806,00, the lot (realized gains, trade returns) 816,00. The drawer has no cash field, so nothing on screen says so; §2 of ADR-0053 would have refused this row at import.

  • 1„Betrag (EUR)“, the drawer's existing label for the cash (the cash form's and the history column's word), shows on a buy or sell that stores its cash and has no settlement legs. Its help line says what it is and what is stored.
  • When quantity, price, fees or taxes change, the field is prefilled with what they derive (816,00), dashed, and an attention note gives the sum and that saving takes what the field states.
  • Saving states the cash: the field is part of the submitted form (ADR point 2), so the PATCH always carries gross_amount.
  • A date, note or account edit leaves the field at the stored figure and shows no note.
  • The refusal is §2's check, the field's own error in the drawer's field-error anatomy: „passt nicht zu Menge × Preis, Gebühren und Steuern — erwartet 816,00“. Nothing is saved.
  • The operator either takes the derived figure or types the broker's statement figure and corrects the price that disagrees with it.

Q4, recommended (b) (the ADR's answer). An imported row's cash is the broker's figure. Under (a) a typo fix in the price silently overwrites it with the app's guess. Under (b) nothing changes that the operator has not seen in the field. (a) is one field fewer to read and is right when the edit is the correction of a typo in a hand-made booking; that case is unaffected, since a hand-made buy stores no cash.

①b — #1369: open lots and the sell preview at the last own trade price Wertpapiere → Helios Solar Systems SE → Trades · Transaktionen → Transaktion erfassen → Verkauf

Today. Helios has no quote. Its head says it counts in the totals at its last own trade price, 19,20 EUR (14.03.2025), since Sprint 22 (#1316); its open lots read „—“ in Letzter and every result column, and the sell preview prices the lots at the latest quote, so Bruttogewinn reads „—“. After. Both read the valuation's rule and name it, with Sprint 22's words.

A sell of 5 Helios from Depot Nord typed into the drawer, not saved. FIFO consumes the 12.02.2025 lot (18,00).

  • 1The preview's price line takes the place of „Bepreist zum zuletzt gespeicherten Preis: …“ when no quote exists: „Bepreist zum letzten eigenen Handelspreis: 19,20 (14.03.2025).“
  • Bruttogewinn +6,00 EUR = 5 × (19,20 − 18,00). A price typed by the operator still wins, as today.
  • No new CSS. The API's sell preview names price_source: trade in its basis.

①c — #1368: the category result at the last own trade price Klassifizierungen → Anlageklasse (Ansicht Alles)

Today. The roll-up prices its members by quotes only (CategoryResult.quote_priced/1), while its „Wert“ column and the member rows already value them at the trade price. So ETF reads Wert 21.493,20 but Einstand 13.000,00 and Ergebnis −869,20 over 2 of 15 positions, and the note lists 19 positions as „kein brauchbarer Kurs“. After. The same rule as the holdings: Einstand 21.749,40, Ergebnis −256,20 (−1,2 %) over all 15; Fund 451,11 / 0,00. The note keeps the three positions no rule can value. Figures computed from the seed's holdings with the trade-price fallback.

1The row figures follow the rule; a member valued at its trade price says „zum Handelspreis“ under its value (.cell-note), and the basis line gains „Kurse: der neueste, ohne Kurs der letzte eigene Handelspreis“, so the rule is stated where the figures are read (UX-DR11). The API's computation_basis names it as well (review-blocking per AGENTS.md).

①d — Sprint 22 R5, drawn after the fact Cashflow → Trades · Übersicht → Abgeschlossene Trades

As built (#1310, #1311; no board before the code, the retrospective's carry-forward). R5 added three exclusion sentences to both notes: a sale or its lot priced in a third currency, a buy paid in another currency than the sale's, and a buy of amount zero, each with its count in the note's lead. The seed has none of these sales, so the three sentences (pins 2–4) carry synthetic names in the live note beside the seed's two real reasons. The notes are drawn expanded („mehr“ pressed).

Found while drawing (S3, polish list „Cash flow“ and „Overview“). (1) On Cash flow → Trades the backfill's method sentence and „Historische Wechselkurse nachladen“ follow every reason, though the three R5 reasons say „which no rate fixes“: with only those reasons the note offers a remedy that cannot act (UX-DR25 clause 3). (2) On the Overview the pointer „Das Nachladen der Wechselkurse steht unter „Alle Trades““ sits after the missing-leg sentence, and with R5's sentences after it, it reads as if it covered them. (3) With five reasons the lead repeats each count once more, so the note runs to nine lines at 1200 px.
